introduction.summary: The study measured the taxonomic and functional trait structure of ground beetle assemblages in restored tallgrass prairies, and also measured seed and arthropod predation to relate management, beetle assemblage characteristics, and function.

methods.summary: This study observed the presence of American bison at various restored and remnant prairie sites within the Nachusa Grasslands ecological restoration project. The study measured various traits of ground-dwelling arthropods, specifically ground beetles, collected from different land management treatments across multiple sites. The study measured seed predation on four prairie plant species and arthropod predation on wax worm larvae across different sites and time points.
